tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind the sidebar and every card; the outer shell.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, popovers, table rows. Sits directly on bg-canvas with no border or shadow.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Active nav item, hover rows, user chat bubbles, in-range calendar days, icon-button hover. Always on bg-surface.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Primary button, selected chip, selected calendar day, composer stop/send button. Text on it is text-inverse.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table row dividers, card section dividers, select and composer outlines. Decorative, never the only signal.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover outline on selects and inputs; dashed chart gridlines.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, metric values, body copy, table cells. On bg-canvas, bg-surface and bg-subtle.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Card labels, captions, axis labels, column headers, nav section headings. On bg-canvas, bg-surface and bg-subtle.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and out-of-month calendar days only (exempt from contrast minimums). Never for information.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bg-inverse.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one signal colour: primary chart line, highlighted bars, gauge progress, legend dot for the primary series. A mark, never a text colour or text background.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Non-highlighted bars, gauge track, comparison line, empty segment-bar track.

tokens.name: positive-text
tokens.usage: Good-change badge text and trend arrows. On positive-subtle and bg-surface.

tokens.name: positive-subtle
tokens.usage: Good-change badge and trend-arrow fill.

tokens.name: negative-text
tokens.usage: Bad-change badge text, trend arrows, Down status. On negative-subtle and bg-surface.

tokens.name: negative-subtle
tokens.usage: Bad-change badge and trend-arrow fill.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Degraded status and warning badges. On warning-subtle and bg-surface. Added for server states; the references have no warning colour.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Degraded status and warning badge fill.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (segment bar, multi-series legend). Marks only; the light categorical hues sit under 3:1 on bg-surface, so every series carries a legend or row label.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2. Marks only.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3. Marks only.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4. Marks only.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5. Marks only; always paired with a legend label.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Same as text, so it clears 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top-left of the main column.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: CPU load is up 7% while error rate dropped 12%.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Card labels (text-muted), nav items, buttons, chips, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Card footnotes, axis labels, column headers, timestamps.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Delta badges and nav section headings only.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The headline figure of a chart card or gauge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges; bar gaps in BarChart.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; icon-to-label gap in nav items and buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar inner padding; gap between a value and its footnote.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page title row and the first card row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Main column padding; gap between chat turns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between sidebar nav block and footer links.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Delta badges, calendar day cells, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Nav items, selects, chips, chat bubbles, composer.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the sidebar panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The outer app shell on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, trend-arrow discs, legend dots, segment bars.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: chart tooltips, select menus, the date picker. Cards never cast shadows.
